content.title: Virginia's Premier Adventure Day Camp | Congressional Day Camp
content.text: Join us for an unforgettable summer at Virginia’s premier Adventure Day Camp! Explore Our Programs With over 80 years of experience, Congressional Camp prides itself on the wide variety of programs offered for campers ages 4 to 14. Click the link below to browse all of our camps or scroll to learn more about specific programs. Day camp is a traditional favorite with activities like sports, horseback riding, archery, arts, ziplining, and taekwondo operating on a 3-day rotating schedule. Daily swimming in our newly renovated pools complete with a diving board, slide, and splash pad is among our most popular activities. Campers are sure to come home every day tired, a little bit messy, and full of fun adventures to share about! Great Adventures is a uniquely designed program for our youngest campers who will be entering Junior Kindergarten (Pre-K) or Kindergarten. This program is based out of our Little School Building and features similar age-adjusted activities to our Day Camp. Great Adventures campers will swim daily in our kids’ pool and splash pad, ride miniature horses, and participate in nature walks, art, science, cooking, and more. Our Specialty Camps are designed to allow for greater exploration into favorite activity areas. In the past, popular offerings have included Pony Camp, Congo Chefs, Engineering and many more. Summer Academy is the newest addition to our program lineup debuting in 2020. These offerings are academic focused and provide daily small group instruction for one hour during the camp day. A variety of courses are available including reading, math, foreign language, and STEM. Campers may be enrolled in Summer Academy and Day Camp simultaneously. For those seeking adventures outside of our campus, check out Travel Camp! These camps depart daily for adventures and excursions in the DC area. Past trips have included water parks, museums, laser tag, bowling, and many more. Our Locations We don’t have enough words of gratitude to express what the Congo Camp staff did for our two children this summer. It’s a true blessing and gift for us to have a place like Congo Camp where we can send both of our kids and know they’re going to have an amazing time under watchful eyes.
